lines.2: 「Yeah. I took them all down. Didn't get hurt either.」
lines.5: 「Sorry things got out of hand like this.」
lines.6: 「Don't be. I only did it because I wanted to cut loose.」
lines.7: 「Those guys were probably the same. Bored with their lives and itching for a fight.」
lines.8: 「Will your track club be okay with this?」
lines.9: 「Hah. If this is enough to cause trouble, I'll gladly quit. My night job is a hell of a lot riskier.」
lines.12: 「Jeez. He worries about every little thing.」
lines.13: 「Hey, you skulking around over there. Gonna abandon your fallen friends and run?」
lines.16: 「Hah... I don't want to go home, but I guess I'll head back and sleep.」
